title: Meyerhoff v. Chesapeake Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC held the complaint moot in view of Case 2008-11 and directed Chesapeake Presbytery to note that result in the minutes of its August 16, 2008 meeting. It did not decide either alleged error on the merits.
first_summary: Meyerhoff challenged Chesapeake Presbytery’s special meeting to receive and discuss an original-jurisdiction commission’s initial report. The SJC held the complaint moot in view of Case 2008-11 and directed Presbytery to record that notation in the meeting minutes, without deciding the alleged procedural errors.
summary: Meyerhoff challenged Chesapeake Presbytery’s called meeting to receive, discuss, and entertain questions about an original-jurisdiction commission’s initial report. Without deciding whether those actions were procedurally erroneous, the SJC held the complaint moot in view of its judgment in Case 2008-11. It directed Presbytery to note the mootness ruling in the minutes of the August 16, 2008 meeting.

evidence_notes.incorporated_decisions: The judgment depends on Case 2008-11, but that decision is not included in the supplied source (printed p. 134, line 53).
